inspiration: OpenVINS saves previous/current pyramids and shares them between detection and temporal matching. Its current pyramid is constructed in a fresh vector; the allocation cache here is a separate ORB experiment.
change: Reuse existing bordered image allocation only if size, type, full parent size and ROI offset match. Preserve resize and border operations. No class layout changes.
limits: Native equality does not establish a whole-estimator CPU saving. Variant adds only buffer reuse to the fixed-point blur candidate.
